name: Dennis B. Laughlin
occupation: Co-owner and general manager, Flaming Gorge Harley-Davidson
background: Dennis B. Laughlin is a Green River resident who ran as the Libertarian nominee for House District 18 in 2022. He lost the Nov. 8, 2022 general election. His Secretary of State general-election filing listed a Green River mailing address.

A SweetwaterNOW Hometown Hustle profile identified him as co-owner of Flaming Gorge Harley-Davidson, the Green River family dealership started in 1986 by his parents, Dave and Lynda Laughlin. The profile said he grew up in the shop, worked through every department, and later became general manager and co-owner. The dealership’s address in that profile was 440 Uinta Drive in Green River.
